page: Amazon Web Services t8i.nano is an entry-level virtual machine built on the AWS Nitro System hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel processor clocked at 3.9 GHz. Compute resources comprise 2 burstable vCPUs mapped across 1 physical core and 2 execution threads, accompanied by 0.5 GB of system RAM, which provides an allocation of 0.25 GB per core.

Hardware expansion and bundled media are minimal on this profile. The t8i.nano includes zero local storage volumes, necessitating network-attached block storage for operating system and data requirements. There are no discrete GPU accelerators available on the system. The networking configuration features a 0 Gbps baseline bandwidth rating and provides no complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the shared-core burstable model and limited 0.5 GB memory footprint, the t8i.nano provides an economical profile for operations requiring low resource density. It is suitable for intermittent background tasks, monitoring daemons, simple proxy services, and lightweight development or staging environments that do not sustain continuous CPU utilization or high memory demands.
